label: TP
reason: User input from HttpServletRequest parameters flows directly into 'param' variable which is then passed to an inner method 'doSomething' where it is assigned to 'bar'. The 'bar' string is printed via response.getWriter().println(bar) without any HTML encoding or sanitization. The X-XSS-Protection header being disabled confirms the application intends to allow script execution, making this a confirmed Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: User parameter extracted from request and passed through inner class method without sanitization
